_note: Stream addresses of common Indian NVR and DVR brands. {auth} is user:password@ (URL encoded), {stream} is the brand's number for the main or sub stream. The substream is the default: the engine analyses about 960 pixels wide at a few frames a second, so the main stream only costs bandwidth. Sources: Hikvision's RTSP note (tb_rtsp_and_http_urls_120915us.pdf), Dahua's realmonitor URL, which CP Plus recorders share.

hikvision.label: Hikvision
hikvision.hint: Camera 1's substream is channel 102, camera 17's is 1702.

cp_plus.label: CP Plus
cp_plus.hint: Recorders use port 554. Some CP Plus cameras on their own use port 5543.
